38162-practical-religion-being-plain-pap.title: Privileges of Professing Christians
38162-practical-religion-being-plain-pap.creator: John Charles Ryle, D.D.,
38162-practical-religion-being-plain-pap.description: A book by John Charles Ryle, D.D.,. This was a wise and useful proposal. Let us lay it to heart, and apply it to ourselves in the nineteenth century. Let us search our ways, and find out how matters stand between ourselves and God. Let us "see how we do." I ask every reader of this volume to begin its perusal by joining me in self-inquiry. If ever self-inquiry about religion was needed, it is needed at the present day.

arxiv-1710-07864.title: Pseudorapidity and transverse momentum dependence of flow harmonics in \Pp ​ Pb \Pp\text{Pb} and PbPb collisions
arxiv-1710-07864.description: Abstract Measurements of azimuthal angular correlations are presented for high-multiplicity pPb collisions at \sqrtsNN = 5.02 \sqrtsNN=5.02 \TeV and peripheral PbPb collisions at \sqrtsNN = 2.76 \sqrtsNN=2.76 \TeV . The data used in this work were collected with the CMS detector at the CERN LHC.

arxiv-2103-08321.title: Territorial differences in the spread of COVID-19 in European regions and US counties
arxiv-2103-08321.creator: Fabrizio Natale, Stefano Maria Iacus, Alessandra Conte, Spyridon Spyratos, Francesco Sermi
arxiv-2103-08321.description: Abstract This article explores the territorial differences in the onset and spread of COVID-19 and the excess mortality associated with the pandemic, across the European NUTS3 regions and US counties. Both in Europe and in the US, the pandemic arrived earlier and recorded higher Rt values in urban regions than in intermediate and rural ones.

arxiv-2108-11492.title: Influence of Solvent Quality on Depletion Potentials in Colloid-Polymer Mixtures
arxiv-2108-11492.creator: Alan R. Denton and Wyatt J. Davis
arxiv-2108-11492.description: Abstract As first explained by the classic Asakura-Oosawa (AO) model, effective attractive forces between colloidal particles induced by depletion of nonadsorbing polymers can drive demixing of colloid-polymer mixtures into colloid-rich and colloid-poor phases, with practical relevance for purification of water, stability of foods and pharmaceuticals, and macromolecular crowding in biological cells.

arxiv-2207-14734.title: Fast quantum circuit cutting with randomized measurements
arxiv-2207-14734.creator: Angus Lowe, Matija Medvidović, Anthony Hayes, Lee J. O’Riordan, Thomas R. Bromley, Juan Miguel Arrazola, Nathan Killoran
arxiv-2207-14734.description: Abstract We propose a method to extend the size of a quantum computation beyond the number of physical qubits available on a single device. This is accomplished by randomly inserting measure-and-prepare channels to express the output state of a large circuit as a separable state across distinct devices.

arxiv-2409-16897.title: HVT: A Comprehensive Vision Framework for Learning in Non-Euclidean Space
arxiv-2409-16897.creator: Jacob Fein-Ashley, Ethan Feng, Minh Pham
arxiv-2409-16897.description: Abstract Data representation in non-Euclidean spaces has proven effective for capturing hierarchical and complex relationships in real-world datasets. Hyperbolic spaces, in particular, provide efficient embeddings for hierarchical structures. This paper introduces the Hyperbolic Vision Transformer (HVT), a novel extension of the Vision Transformer (ViT) that integrates hyperbolic geometry.

arxiv-2508-12585.title: The highest mass Kepler red giants— II. Spectroscopic parameters, the amplitude-activity relation, and unexpected halo orbits 2025 The highest mass Kepler red giants— II. Spectroscopic parameters, the amplitude-activity relation, and unexpected halo orbits – References
arxiv-2508-12585.creator: Courtney L. Crawford, Yaguang Li (李亚光), Daniel Huber, Jie Yu (余杰), Timothy R. Bedding, Sarah L. Martell, Benjamin T. Montet, Dennis Stello, Howard Isaacson, Andrew W. Howard, Benjamin J. Fulton, Jingwen Zhang, Alex S. Polanski, Lauren M. Weiss
arxiv-2508-12585.description: Abstract The high-mass (M > > 2 M ⊙ \text{M}_{\odot} ) Kepler red giant stars are less well-studied than their lower-mass counterparts. In the previous article, we presented a sample of 48 high-mass Kepler red giants and measured their asteroseismic parameters.

arxiv-2510-25665.title: Fuzz Smarter, Not Harder: Towards Greener Fuzzing with GreenAFL
arxiv-2510-25665.creator: Ayse Irmak Ercevik, Aidan Dakhama, Melane Navaratnarajah, Yazhuo Cao, Leo Fernandes
arxiv-2510-25665.description: Abstract Fuzzing has become a key search-based technique for software testing, but continuous fuzzing campaigns consume substantial computational resources and generate significant carbon footprints. Existing grey-box fuzzing approaches like AFL++ focus primarily on coverage maximisation, without considering the energy costs of exploring different execution paths.

britannica-1911-goslicki-wawrzyniec.title: Goslicki, Wawrzyniec (1911 Encyclopaedia Britannica article)
britannica-1911-goslicki-wawrzyniec.creator: Encyclopaedia Britannica
britannica-1911-goslicki-wawrzyniec.description: Article 'Goslicki, Wawrzyniec' from the 1911 Encyclopædia Britannica (Volume 12), the classic English-language general encyclopedia, now in the public domain. better known under his Latinized name of Laurentius Grimalius Goslicius, was born about 1533. After having studied at Cracow and Padua, he entered the church, and was successively appointed bishop of Kaminietz and of Posen. Goslicki was an active man of business, was held in high estimation by his contemporaries and was frequently engaged in political affairs.

pmc-10672320.title: Visual Impairment and Low Vision Aids—A Comparison between Children and Adults
pmc-10672320.creator: Madeleine A Perrault, Gabriele Lauer, Sabine Voss, Berthold Seitz, Barbara Käsmann-Kellner, Riccardo Di Iorio
pmc-10672320.description: (1) Background: This study aims to highlight differences in the etiology and fitting of low vision aids in visually impaired children and adolescents in comparison to adults. (2) Methods: A retrospective data collection from visually impaired patients presenting to obtain assistive devices from 1 January 2016 to 30 April 2020 was conducted. A total of 502 patients were included.

pmc-11436330.title: The Normal Growth Rate of Human Fingernails in Indian Population
pmc-11436330.creator: Vishnu Babu, Mohamed Ibrahim, Shyamnath Krishna Pandian K, Latha Madhavan, Anirudha N. Sharma, Krishnamoorthy R., Mukund Thatte, Anil Bhat, Sridhar K.
pmc-11436330.description: Background: India, with a large population working in industries, has a considerable amount of nail bed injuries day to day as well as infections and other issues with nails. However, there are no normative data for nail growth in our population.

pmc-11437786.title: Predictive factors for deep medial collateral ligament release in adjusted mechanical alignment total knee arthroplasty
pmc-11437786.creator: Nimit Thongpulsawasdi, Chaiwat Achawakulthep, Tawan Intiyanaravut, Chirathit Anusitviwat, Varah Yuenyongviwat
pmc-11437786.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). BackgroundTotal knee arthroplasty (TKA) demands precision in achieving optimal alignment and soft tissue balance, especially in cases of medial compartment osteoarthritis where the need for medial soft tissue release is critical yet challenging to ascertain.ObjectiveThis study aims to systematically investigate the relationship between preoperative data, initial knee conditions and the necessity for deep collateral ligament (MCL) release in adjusted mechanical alignment total knee arthroplasty.MethodsWe conducted a retrospective study involving 61 TKA patients who underwent adjusted mechanical alignment robotic-assisted procedures.

pmc-11620094.title: High heritability of human facial traits reveals associations with CNTLN, BRCA1, and TMPRSS6 loci in Korean families
pmc-11620094.creator: Donghyun Lee, Hyo-Jeong Ban, Kyung-Won Hong, Jong Young Lee, Seongwon Cha
pmc-11620094.description: Facial features are determined by interactions between genetic and environmental factors. However, genes underlying facial similarities in individuals from the same family remain less explored. To identify genetic variants associated with heritable facial features, we investigated familial (parent–offspring) associations and estimated familial correlation and heritability using 39 facial measurements in 408 individuals from 117 Korean families.

pmc-12630845.title: Cascading marginal emissions signals for green charging with growing electric vehicle adoption
pmc-12630845.creator: Sonia Martin, Siobhan Powell, Ram Rajagopal
pmc-12630845.description: Shifting electric vehicle charging to use cleaner electricity can reduce carbon dioxide emissions. Grid emissions factors can inform when to shift demand, but key assumptions behind existing emissions factor methods fail for today’s grids and electric vehicle adoption levels. We combine real charging data with a Western U.S. grid model to test these methods under increasing electric vehicle adoption.

pmc-12675600.title: Women’s Experiences with Exercise-Induced Orgasm: Findings from Qualitative Interviews
pmc-12675600.creator: Debby Herbenick, Callie Patterson Perry, J Dennis Fortenberry, Ruhun Wasata, Jodi Wilson, Owen Miller, Kayla Willens, Alyssa Williams, Georgia Frey
pmc-12675600.description: Exercise-induced arousal (EIA) and exercise-induced orgasm (EIO) have been described as occurring from engaging in exercise or physical activities that are vigorous, repetitive, or demanding of core abdominal muscles, usually apart from sexual situations and without direct genital stimulation. Few existing studies have examined EIA/EIO, and no prior studies have qualitatively explored these experiences.

pmc-12788720.title: Characterisation of new HIV diagnoses achieved in emergency departments using an opt-in strategy, Catalonia, Spain, July 2021 to March 2024
pmc-12788720.creator: Jordi Llaneras, Patricia Álvarez-López, Rocío de Paz, Míriam Carbó, Mireia Saura, Alexis Rebollo, Cristina Olaizola, Neus Robert, Alberto Carrillo, Cristina Ramió, Emma Picart, Josep Maria Guardiola, Àlex Smithson, Ferran Rodríguez-Masià, Connie Leey, Laura González-García, Ignacio Ferro, Mariola Mi
pmc-12788720.description: BACKGROUNDHIV screening strategies in alternative settings, such as emergency departments (EDs), aim to increase diagnosis of occult infections and achieve 95–95–95 targets for 2030.AIMTo assess the effectiveness of an opt-in HIV screening strategy in EDs based on six clinical scenarios from a 2020 Spanish consensus document, while examining patient characteristics and linkage to-care.

pmc-13100983.title: Toxicity, Chemistry, and Public Health Relevance of Emerging Nicotine Analog Vapes, Pods, and Pouches
pmc-13100983.creator: Rhea Raghu, Mohana Sengupta, Karen Lin, Felix Effah, Robert M. Strongin, Irfan Rahman
pmc-13100983.description: Electronic nicotine delivery system manufacturers, such as Charlie’s Holdings Inc., ECBlend, Outlaw, and NicRiver, have recently introduced nicotine analogs, such as 6-methyl nicotine, 6-MN (“Metatine”), and nicotinamide, NA (“Nixamide,” “Nixodine,” or “Nixotin-free base and salt”) in products to circumvent the U.S. FDA’s premarket tobacco product application (PMTA) requirements.

pmc-13205400.title: Efficiency of Four Irrigation Needles in Curved Simulated Root Canals
pmc-13205400.creator: Benedicte Elisabeth Strand, Marianne Lægreid, Inge Fristad
pmc-13205400.description: Background/Objectives: Effective irrigation of the apical third remains one of the greatest challenges in root canal treatment, particularly in curved canals where anatomical complexity restricts irrigant penetration. This in vitro study evaluated the irrigation efficacy of four syringe-needle designs under standardized conditions. Methods: Ten transparent resin blocks with approximately 30° curved canals were instrumented to size 30/0.04 taper.

An officer or employee of the Bureau of Prisons may— (1) make arrests on or off of Bureau of Prisons property without warrant for violations of the following provisions regardless of where the violation may occur: sections 111 (assaulting.
